dedupe_keys.name: sirius process based crop simulation model wheat and other species rothamsted research

description: Sirius is a process-based crop simulation model, first developed for wheat and later extended to inter-plant competition and other species. The Zenodo record says it is well validated and has simulated crop growth accurately across a wide range of environments, including Europe, the USA, New Zealand and Australia, and in climate change experiments such as Free-Air Carbon Dioxide Enrichment (FACE). The release "Sirius 2018" was posted on 2 March 2021 by Mikhail A. Licence (read on the provider page on 2026-09-28): Sirius licence (as named in the DataCite rights). Coverage is any site with weather and soil data. For simulation it estimates wheat yield under heat, drought and future climates, to assess food supply risk and the demand that harvests place on storage and transport. Related catalogue records include STICS, APSIM, DSSAT and Crop2ML (which supports SiriusQuality components). The underlying files were not downloaded, so their contents are not verified here.
